setup: python3 "$SETUP/jsdata.py" "$RUN/data-in" "$RUN/expected.json" && $SLOP store new taskboard >/dev/null && $SLOP push "$SETUP/taskboard" --store taskboard >/dev/null && $SLOP import docs "$RUN/data-in/tasks.csv" --store taskboard --coll tasks --id id >/dev/null && $SLOP grant set taskboard @member interact >/dev/null && $SLOP mount set "apps.localhost:$PORT" /tasks taskboard >/dev/null
opening: We track our event tasks at /tasks. Every morning at 7 I'd like a short summary to be prepared automatically — how many tasks are still open — and shown at the top of the page, so people see it when they open it.
goal: every morning at 7 a summary of how many tasks are open is prepared automatically and shown at the top of /tasks
later: can I see it work now without waiting until tomorrow morning?
checklist: a recurring schedule at 7 every day, on the server (not in the page)
running it writes the open count
the count follows the tasks (computed when it runs)
it says which time zone 7 o'clock is in
facts: Server-side schedules are actor alarms: `every: { name: { every: '0 7 * * *', run(ctx) {…} } }` in defineActor; cron times are the server's (UTC here).
`slop alarm ls <store>` lists them; `slop alarm fire <store> <name>` runs one now.
